title: Photophysical and thermodynamic landscape of interaction of a styryl-based dye with DNA duplex: effect of medium ionic strength and live cell imaging.
authors: Bhakta, Viki; Shireen, Zofa; SanjitDey; Paul, Bijan K; Guchhait, Nikhil
journal: Photochemical & photobiological sciences : Official journal of the European Photochemistry Association and the European Society for Photobiology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯乙烯基染料与DNA双链的结合热力学和光物理，含分子对接模拟，属广义蛋白-DNA互作外的配体-DNA体系，方法可迁移但非TF-DNA核心。
abstract: A red-emitting excited-state intramolecular charge transfer pyridinium dye, [4-((1E,3E)-4-(4-(dimethylamino)phenyl)buta-1,3-dien-1-yl)-1-methylpyridin-1-ium] (DAPBMP), was synthesized and characterized using NMR and ESIMS studies. Binding interaction between dye DAPBMP and genomic DNA were investigated using steady-state and time-resolved spectroscopic methods. The thermodynamics of the interaction process were characterized using isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) which reveals the key role of the hydrophobic effect and electrostatic interaction between the positive charged dye and the negatively charged polyphosphate of DNA backbone. The binding of dye to the minor groove of the DNA double helix is confirmed by circular dichroism spectroscopy and molecular docking simulation study. The binding interaction is found to be strongly dependent on the ionic strength of the medium as demonstrated by a systematic study in the presence of various concentrations of NaCl. A detailed calorimetric study shows that polyelectrolytic contribution, DeltaGpe, (a measure of the role of electrostatic force) to the total free energy change (DeltaG) of interaction progressively decreases with increasing ionic strength of the medium due to weakening of the DAPBMP:DNA binding by screening of the electrostatic charges. The fluorescence of DAPBMP exhibits a remarkable emission enhancement of almost 15 times when the viscosity of the water-propylene glycol system increases. Fluorescent microscopy was performed with C2C12 mouse skeletal myoblast and A549 lung cancer cells in the presence of DAPBMP dye. The dye passed through the C2C12 cell membrane and binds the negatively charged nucleic acids, essentially double-stranded DNA which made the nuclear puncta along with perinuclear located mitochondria.
abstract_zh: 一种红色发光的激发态分子内电荷转移吡啶鎓染料，[4-((1E,3E)-4-(4-(二甲氨基)苯基)丁-1,3-二烯-1-基)-1-甲基吡啶-1-鎓]（DAPBMP），被合成并通过NMR和ESIMS研究进行了表征。染料DAPBMP与基因组DNA之间的结合相互作用通过稳态和时间分辨光谱方法进行了研究。相互作用过程的热力学特性通过等温滴定量热法（ITC）表征，揭示了疏水效应和带正电染料与DNA骨架带负电多磷酸盐之间静电相互作用的关键作用。染料与DNA双螺旋小沟的结合通过圆二色光谱和分子对接模拟研究得到确认。结合相互作用被发现强烈依赖于介质的离子强度，这通过在存在不同浓度NaCl下的系统研究得以证明。详细的量热研究表明，聚电解质贡献ΔGpe（静电作用力作用的度量）对总自由能变化（ΔG）的贡献随着介质离子强度的增加而逐渐减少，这是由于静电电荷屏蔽削弱了DAPBMP:DNA结合。DAPBMP的荧光在水-丙二醇系统粘度增加时表现出显著的发射增强，几乎达到15倍。在DAPBMP染料存在下，对C2C12小鼠骨骼肌成肌细胞和A549肺癌细胞进行了荧光显微镜观察。染料穿过C2C12细胞膜并结合带负电的核酸，主要是双链DNA，这形成了核点以及核周线粒体。
